editorial.blurb: Cafe Istanbul delivers authentic Turkish cuisine with generous portions and bold, well-seasoned flavors that transport diners straight to Turkey.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the brunch deal to enjoy meze shared family-style, and arrive early on weekends—a 40-minute wait is common but worth it for the attentive service.

topDishes.note: delicious and full of flavor, seasoned protein with rice
standout lamb skewer, flavorful and perfectly cooked
